articles.title_cn: 身份认同是否影响劳动力供给？
articles.abstract_en: How does identity influence economic behavior in the labor market? I investigate this question in rural India, focusing on the effect of caste identity on job-specific labor supply. In a field experiment, laborers choose whether to take up various job offers, which differ in associations with specific castes. Workers are less willing to accept offers that are linked to castes other than their own, especially when those castes rank lower in the social hierarchy. Workers forgo large payments to avoid job offers that conflict with their caste identity, even when these decisions are made in private.
articles.abstract_cn: 身份认同如何影响劳动力市场中的经济行为？我在印度农村地区研究这一问题，重点关注种姓身份对特定工作劳动力供给的影响。在一项实地实验中，劳动者选择是否接受各种工作机会，这些工作机会与特定种姓相关联。工人不太愿意接受与自己种姓不同的工作机会，尤其是当这些种姓在社会等级中排名较低时。即使这些决定是在私下做出的，工人也会放弃大额报酬以避免与其种姓身份相冲突的工作机会。

articles.abstract_en: The reversal interest rate is the rate at which accommodative monetary policy reverses and becomes contractionary for lending. We theoretically demonstrate its existence in a macroeconomic model featuring imperfectly competitive banks that face financial frictions. When interest rates are cut too low, further monetary stimulus cuts into banks' profit margins, depressing their net worth and curtailing their credit supply. Similarly, when interest rates are low for too long, the persistent drag on bank profitability eventually outweighs banks' initial capital gains, also stifling credit supply. We quantify the importance of this mechanism within a calibrated New Keynesian model.
articles.abstract_cn: 逆转利率是指宽松货币政策逆转并对贷款产生紧缩效应的利率水平。我们在理论上证明了其在包含面临金融摩擦的不完全竞争银行的宏观经济模型中的存在性。当利率降得过低时，进一步的货币刺激会削减银行的利润空间，压低其净值并限制其信贷供给。同样，当利率长期维持低位时，对银行盈利能力的持续拖累最终会超过银行最初的资本收益，从而也抑制信贷供给。我们在校准的新凯恩斯模型中量化了这一机制的重要性。

articles.title_en: Individuals and Organizations as Sources of State Effectiveness
articles.title_cn: 个人和组织作为国家有效性的来源
articles.abstract_en: Bureaucrats implement policy. How important are they for a state's productivity? And do the trade-offs between policies depend on their effectiveness? Using data on 16 million public purchases in Russia, we show that 39 percent of the variation in prices paid for narrowly defined items is due to the individual bureaucrats and organizations who manage procurement. Low-price buyers also display higher spending quality. Theory suggests that such differences in effectiveness can be pivotal for policy design. To illustrate, we show that a common one—bid preferences for domestic suppliers—substantially improves procurement performance, but only when implemented by ineffective bureaucrats.
articles.abstract_cn: 官僚执行政策。它们对于一个国家的生产力有多重要？政策之间的权衡是否取决于其有效性？使用俄罗斯 16 百万公共采购的数据，我们表明 39% 狭义项目支付的价格变化是由管理采购的各个官僚和组织造成的。低价买家也表现出较高的消费质量。理论表明，这种有效性差异对于政策设计至关重要。为了说明这一点，我们证明了一个常见的现象——对国内供应商的投标偏好——可以显着提高采购绩效，但前提是由效率低下的官僚机构实施。

articles.title_en: The Political Economy of International Regulatory Cooperation
articles.title_cn: 国际监管合作的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: We examine international regulatory agreements that are negotiated under lobbying pressures from producer groups. The way in which lobbying influences the cooperative setting of regulatory policies, as well as the welfare impacts of international agreements, depend crucially on whether the interests of producers in different countries are aligned or in conflict. The former situation tends to occur for product standards, while the latter tends to occur for process standards. We find that, if producer lobbies are strong enough, agreements on product standards lead to excessive deregulation and decrease welfare, while agreements on process standards tighten regulations and enhance welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了在生产者群体游说压力下谈判达成的国际监管协议。游说影响合作性监管政策制定的方式，以及国际协议的福利影响，关键取决于不同国家生产者的利益是一致还是冲突。前者往往出现在产品标准中，而后者往往出现在过程标准中。我们发现，如果生产者游说足够强大，产品标准协议会导致过度放松监管并降低福利，而过程标准协议则会加强监管并提高福利。

articles.title_en: The Micro Anatomy of Macro Consumption Adjustments
articles.title_cn: 宏观消费调整的微观解剖
articles.abstract_en: We study crises characterized by large adjustments of aggregate consumption through their microlevel patterns. We document the cross-sectional patterns of consumption adjustment across the income distribution and find large adjustments for top-income households, who exhibit consumption-income elasticities similar to or larger than the average. We construct a heterogeneous-agent open economy model of consumption under income fluctuations and show that the data patterns are largely consistent with theories that attribute the dynamics of aggregate consumption to changes in aggregate permanent income. We also discuss our findings' implications for theories based on the tightening of households' borrowing constraints and analyze policy implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过微观层面的模式来研究以总消费大幅调整为特征的危机。我们记录了收入分配中消费调整的横截面模式，并发现高收入家庭的大幅调整，其消费-收入弹性与平均水平相似或更大。我们构建了一个收入波动下消费的异质性主体开放经济模型，并表明数据模式在很大程度上与将总消费动态归因于总永久收入变化的理论一致。我们还讨论了我们的发现对基于家庭借贷约束收紧的理论的政策含义，并分析了政策影响。

articles.title_en: The Missing Intercept: A Demand Equivalence Approach
articles.title_cn: 缺失截距：一种需求等价方法
articles.abstract_en: I give conditions under which changes in private spending are accommodated in general equilibrium exactly like changes in aggregate fiscal expenditure. Under such demand equivalence, researchers can use time series evidence on fiscal multipliers to recover the general equilibrium "missing intercept" of shocks to private spending identified in the cross section. Through the lens of this theory, time series estimates of a fiscal multiplier around one suggest a missing intercept close to zero—an observation that I illustrate with an application to the 2008 tax rebates. I also discuss the robustness of this aggregation approach to plausible violations of demand equivalence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我给出了在一般均衡中私人支出变化与总财政支出变化完全相同的条件。在这种需求等价下，研究人员可以利用财政乘数的时间序列证据来恢复横截面中识别的私人支出冲击的一般均衡“缺失截距”。通过这一理论的视角，财政乘数约为一的时间序列估计表明缺失截距接近于零——我通过将其应用于2008年税收返还来说明这一观察。我还讨论了这种聚合方法对需求等价可能违反的稳健性。
